system.description: Peoples fundamentally shaped by an elemental, celestial, infernal, astral, or void force. Choose an Origin (Earth, Stone, Metal, Crystal, Flame, Water, Air, Frost, Storm, Celestial, Infernal, Astral, Void, or similar).

nature.name: Planar Attunement
nature.text: Ordinary environmental exposure directly associated with your Origin does not harm you. You immediately recognize significant manifestations of that Origin and can sense a concealed concentration within 2 units, provided it is not contained behind a sealed supernatural barrier. This does not protect you from attacks or other hostile effects. Choose one Planarborn Adaptation.

adaptations.name: Aegis of Origin
adaptations.text: Gain one narrow Resistance associated with your Origin. The Resistance must be approved by the GM and cannot apply to an overly broad category of Damage.

adaptations.name: Dense Form
adaptations.text: Reduce involuntary movement against you by 1 unit. You also count as substantially larger when lifting, carrying, pushing, or resisting ordinary environmental forces.

adaptations.name: Shaper
adaptations.text: Once per turn, you may manipulate a small amount of ordinary material or energy associated with your Origin in an adjacent unoccupied space. You may create or remove 1 unit of difficult terrain, produce a simple shape, or cause a comparable environmental change. You may maintain only one altered space at a time.

adaptations.name: Planar Vessel
adaptations.text: Once per adventure, when you would spend the final point of one of your Resources, retain 1 point instead. The Resource must be chosen when you select this Adaptation and should reflect your Origin.
